author: Malvinarum
name: SystemdManager
description: Manage Linux systemd services (Start/Stop/Restart) via a Discord persistent panel.
install_msg:
⚠️ **IMPORTANT**: This cog requires the bot's user to have NOPASSWD sudo access to `/bin/systemctl` on the host machine.

Run `sudo visudo` and add:
`your_user ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /bin/systemctl`

Without this, commands will fail silently or return permission errors.
